The first chart below illustrates price changes over time across major CPI categories, showing how inflation has affected different parts of the economy. The chart tracks percentage price changes from January 2019 through September 2026.

Hover over the chart to view specific data points, or select a category from the legend on the right to highlight it. This makes it easy to follow how prices in individual CPI categories have changed over time.
